title: The Congregation Seeks Hukam for the Kasur Assault

blocks.text: Military caution gives way to religious decision. As arguments continue over delay and reinforcement, the congregation accepts that the matter should be placed before the Guru rather than settled by calculation alone.

The proposal carries the whole body with it, and the whole congregation moved to take hukam from Guru Granth Sahib. In this telling, the campaign is not only a retaliation for one Brahmin household, but a mission requiring collective ardas and explicit spiritual sanction.

The page closes with the hukam process underway and the sangat ready to hear whether Kasur should be struck. Debate, prayer, and common consent are fused into a single turning point before the march begins.
